**Anthropic Claude** is a **generative AI assistant** and family of **large language models** developed by **Anthropic**.[1][2][8]

In practical terms, Claude is a chatbot and productivity tool that can help with **writing, summarization, coding, Q&A, research, and other text-based tasks**.[2][6][10] Anthropic describes it as built to be **helpful, honest, and harmless**, with a strong emphasis on **safety and reliability**.[2][9][14]

A few useful details:
- Claude is available through **Claude.ai**, mobile apps, and API access for developers.[1][8][10]
- It is a **proprietary** model family, meaning Anthropic controls direct access to it.[8]
- Anthropic has released multiple Claude model variants over time, such as **Haiku**, **Sonnet**, and **Opus**, which differ in speed, cost, and capability.[6][7][11]

If you want, I can also explain **how Claude compares with ChatGPT** or **which Claude model is best for different tasks**.
